AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Not a general NumPy/JAX replacement or complex AD system. No general reduced inverse Hessian or identification of finite Newton traces with implicit derivatives. An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.
